note: Every value published by this dashboard is read from one of these sources on the access date. A source listed here was opened and read during this session; it is not a citation copied from another document.

tiers.A: Primary official government or regulator record (BLS, Census, CA DOF, CA DIR, City of LA, LA County, CDE, USGS, CAL FIRE, IRS, U.S. Treasury).
tiers.B: Primary issuer filing with a securities regulator (SEC EDGAR 8-K / 10-K / 10-Q).
tiers.C: Analyst assumption published by this workbook - not a fact and never presented as one.
tiers.D: Secondary or commercial commentary. Used for orientation only, never for a published value.

sources.publisher: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Western Information Office
sources.title: Los Angeles Area Economic Summary (updated November 04, 2026)
sources.supports: Unemployment rates (US, CA, LA metro, LA County, LA city), nonfarm payroll levels and 12-month changes by sector, QCEW average weekly wage, CPI-U, ECI, employer compensation costs, occupational wages.

sources.title: QuickFacts: Los Angeles city, California (V2025 population estimates; 2020-2024 ACS 5-year; 2022 Economic Census)
sources.supports: City population and change, age structure, race/Hispanic origin, foreign-born share, households, housing tenure, home value, gross rent, education attainment, labor force participation, retail and food-service sales, density, travel time, income and poverty.

sources.title: QuickFacts: Los Angeles County, California (V2025 population estimates; 2020-2024 ACS 5-year; 2022 Economic Census)
sources.supports: County population and change, age structure, Hispanic origin, foreign-born share, density, land area, employer establishments and employment, annual payroll, retail and food-service sales, median household income, per capita income, poverty rate, travel time.

sources.publisher: California Department of Finance, Demographic Research Unit
sources.title: Report P-2A: Total Population Projections, California Counties, 2020-2070 (2024 Baseline; Vintage 2026 Release, updated 2026-03-13)
sources.supports: Official state population projections for Los Angeles County (FIPS 6037), all ages / all sexes / all races, by single year 2020-2070.

sources.title: Gross Domestic Product by County and Personal Income by County, 2024 (BEA 26-08, released February 5, 2026)
sources.supports: Total personal income by county; Los Angeles County total personal income of $818.5 billion, the largest of any U.S. county in 2024.

sources.title: District Profile: Los Angeles Unified, school year 2025-26
sources.supports: LAUSD enrollment and English learner counts and share for 2025-26.

sources.publisher: Jack in the Box Inc. (CIK 0000807882) via SEC EDGAR
sources.title: Form 8-K Exhibit 99.1 - Third Quarter Fiscal 2026 Earnings Release, quarter ended July 5, 2026 (filed 2026-08-12, accession 0000807882-26-000090)
sources.supports: Restaurant counts and franchised share, same-store sales, revenue, net earnings, balance sheet (debt, lease liabilities, stockholders' deficit, cash), FY2026 guidance including closure programme, dividend suspension, Del Taco divestiture, systemwide sales.

sources.publisher: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, EDGAR company filing index
sources.title: Jack in the Box Inc. filing index (CIK 0000807882) - 10-K and 10-Q series
sources.supports: Existence, filing dates and accession numbers of the issuer's annual and quarterly reports (used to confirm the 2025-11-19 Form 10-K is the latest annual report on file).

sources.publisher: U.S. Department of the Treasury, Office of Debt Management
sources.title: Daily Treasury Par Yield Curve Rates, November 2026
sources.supports: Constant-maturity par yields for 1 month to 30 years, including the 10-year rate on 2026-11-06 used as the discount-rate anchor.

sources.publisher: City of Los Angeles Office of Finance
sources.title: Real Property Transfer Tax and Measure ULA FAQ
sources.supports: City base real property transfer tax rate, Measure ULA surtax rates and the post-June 30, 2026 thresholds, annual CPI indexation of thresholds, exemptions.

sources.publisher: Los Angeles County Office of the Assessor
sources.title: Real Property Assessment - An Overview of Property Taxes (Proposition 13)
sources.supports: 1% maximum levy, 2% annual assessed-value increase cap, reassessment on change of ownership or new construction, supplemental assessment mechanics.

sources.title: Like-Kind Exchanges Under IRC Section 1031, Fact Sheet FS-2008-18
sources.supports: Qualification rules, 45-day identification and 180-day completion limits, qualified intermediary requirement, treatment of cash and debt relief, deferred-not-forgiven basis carryover.

sources.publisher: California Department of Industrial Relations, Labor Commissioner's Office
sources.title: Minimum Wage Frequently Asked Questions (2026 rate)
sources.supports: California state minimum wage of $16.90 per hour effective January 1, 2026, and the statutory indexation rule.

sources.publisher: California Department of Industrial Relations, Labor Commissioner's Office
sources.title: Fast Food Minimum Wage Frequently Asked Questions (AB 1228 / Labor Code 1474-1476)
sources.supports: $20.00 per hour fast-food minimum wage effective April 1, 2024, coverage of franchisees, Fast Food Council authority, local-wage interaction.

sources.publisher: City of Los Angeles Office of Wage Standards
sources.title: Minimum Wage and Paid Sick Leave - 2026 Minimum Wage
sources.supports: City of Los Angeles minimum wage of $18.42 per hour effective July 1, 2026, indexed annually to CPI-W.

sources.title: What is the probability that an earthquake will occur in the Los Angeles area? (UCERF3)
sources.supports: 30-year probabilities for M>=6.7, M>=7.0 and M>=7.5 earthquakes in the Los Angeles region.

sources.publisher: CAL FIRE - Office of the State Fire Marshal
sources.title: Fire Hazard Severity Zones (FHSZ) programme and maps
sources.supports: Definition of the Moderate / High / Very High hazard classes, State and Local Responsibility Area mapping programme, and the fact that hazard classification is parcel-specific.
